title: Dan Tepfer: NPR Music Tiny Desk Concert
summary: A Tiny Desk concert in which pianist Dan Tepfer plays with a Disklavier player piano driven by a program he wrote that responds to his playing. He performs four pieces from his Natural Machines project.
why: HN points to it as an example of algorithmic, reactive live music that blends programming with jazz performance.

quote.text: Also check out Dan Tepfer [1] who is doing amazing work with an algorithmic approach to reactive live performances
